data.one_liner: A collection of custom linting rules for Flutter and Dart projects and packages.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of lint rules divided into core, package, and extra sets. It helps enforce code consistency, readability, safety, and performance without being annoying, and includes an analyzer plugin with custom diagnostics.
use_when: You want consistent lint rules across your Dart and Flutter projects.
You want to enforce safety, readability, and performance standards through additional lints.
avoid_when: You prefer using standard default lints without any custom additions.
You do not want to use analyzer plugins or custom lint diagnostics.
strengths: Includes multiple rule sets tailored for projects or packages.
Comes with an analyzer plugin for custom diagnostics and automatic rule configurations.
weaknesses: Requires adherence to a specific opinionated set of coding style rules.
data.setup_notes: Add rexios_lints to dev_dependencies and include the desired ruleset in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official official lint rules from the Dart team if you want standard rather than custom opinions.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official lint rules recommended for Flutter apps by the Flutter team.

data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  rexios_lints: latest

# In analysis_options.yaml:
include: package:rexios_lints/flutter/core.yaml
